annotations.title: Company financials: income statement, balance sheet, cash flow

description: Company financial statements for a US-listed company by ticker or CIK, from its SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings (XBRL): revenue, gross profit, operating and net income, EPS, cash, assets, debt, equity, operating cash flow, capex, free cash flow, dividends and buybacks, with margins, growth, ROE and current ratio. Annual or quarterly, up to 10 periods. Use for fundamentals, a valuation or a company comparison. Example: ticker=AAPL. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (instead of ticker)

ticker.description: Stock ticker or company name, e.g. AAPL (or give cik)
